253:t_1:81.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's the spirit, $$勝平$$! $$ノノ$$ will do her best, too!」

253:t_1:83.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll do it, too! If we keep fighting, I'm sure I'll see $$グーラ$$ again!」

253:t_1:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! Yes! $$ノノ$$ supports your friendship with $$グーラ$$, too, $$正太郎$$!」

253:t_1:85.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're so quick to jump on the bandwagon...」

253:t_1:86.en:
$$チコ$$
「Don't be like that, Princess. At times like this, you have to get excited with everyone.」

253:t_1:88.en:
$$チコ$$
「Maybe that girl's hard work and guts rubbed off on me.」

253:t_1:89.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's give it our all together, $$ラルク$$, with hard work and guts.」

253:t_1:90.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That aside, I'll fight to get back to Earth.」

253:t_1:91.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Earth is important to me, too.」

253:t_1:93.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Yes, yes. Stop that overbearing enthusiasm.」

253:t_1:95.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Let's stoke the flames in our hearts and do our best!」

253:t_1:96.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Now there are two of you being overbearing!」

253:t_1:100.en:
$n
(I'll survive, whatever it takes... and return to Earth.)

253:t_1:101.en:
$n
(We have enemies we have to fight to protect that planet...)

253:t_10:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Well... Let's get started. $n is waiting for his turn after this.」

253:t_10:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Don't worry. I'll finish this quickly.」

253:t_10:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's a pretty good joke for you! Come on, $$隼人$$!」

253:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Um... Is it all right to leave them alone, $$弁慶$$...?」

253:t_10:9.en:
$$弁慶$$
「It's their way of saying hello after being apart. They'll stop when they get bored.」

253:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「True, the atmosphere isn't as hostile as their words sound.」

253:t_10:11.en:
$$弁慶$$
「We respect each other's abilities in our own way. We couldn't be a team otherwise.」

253:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're quite right. When you, $$竜馬$$, $$隼人$$, and $$弁慶$$ each shot down an enemy in the last battle...」

253:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It produced 100Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

253:t_10:14.en:
$$弁慶$$
「...Well, I'm tired of watching. I'll get some exercise myself so this artificial gravity doesn't make me soft.」

253:t_10:15.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$甲児$$, $n, $$シモン$$, $$ヴィラル$$! Aren't you bored just watching, too?!」

253:t_10:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Of course I'm bored after seeing a fight like that up close.」

253:t_10:17.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$隼人$$ is my prey. I won't let $$竜馬$$ have him.」

253:t_10:18.en:
$n
「Then, since I promised him, I'll take on $$竜馬$$.」

253:t_10:19.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then let's go! Let's have ourselves a good time!」

253:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...This is good! Very good! I can't wait to see how many $$Ｚチップ$$s these men's heated battle produces!」

253:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I'm so glad you're safe!」

253:t_10:29.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And everyone told me you used the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ to search for us, $$ＡＧ$$.」

253:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ is crystallized $$Ｚチップ$$s, so it responds to people's feelings and wishes.」

253:t_10:31.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then it picked up our desire to return to everyone.」

253:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, it also picked up all sorts of other feelings spilling out of the $$ジェニオン$$.」

253:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There were Miss $$スズネ$$'s private lessons with the stars of the galaxy as a backdrop...」

253:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard it all, loud and clear.」

253:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You... seem to have a death wish.」

253:t_10:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well, fine. Destroying you would make things inconvenient afterward.」

253:t_10:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't make me angry, $$ＡＧ$$. You know what'll happen if you do, don't you?」

253:t_10:44.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're a good boy. Show some restraint from now on.」

253:t_10:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...No... After that, there's no need to call her 'Miss.'」

253:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I never expected the plan I'd almost given up on to come back to life here... I have $n to thank for that, too.)

253:t_10:48.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I'll give it my all, too! Even at the galactic center... Business, business!」

254:t_002:4.en:
$n
「It was so funny I couldn't help myself.」

254:t_002:5.en:
$n
「We got thrown who knows where, and we're still running into them...!」

254:t_003:0.en:
$n
「They don't seem willing to let us escape! Here we go, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

254:t_003:2.en:
$n
「There must be a force controlling these things!」

254:t_003:3.en:
$n
「Depending on the situation, we'll defeat them and secure a base for our operations from here on!」

254:t_003:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What do I do...? Even in this situation... my heart won't stop pounding...)

254:t_003:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
(...I've decided, $n... I'll follow you, no matter what...)

254:t_003:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Even if the end of the world is approaching, I'll believe in the strength you're striving for.)
